title: Destruction and Backlash
text: Error deals 5 base true damage to creatures and tries to break blocks with iron-tier mining capability. Each level of Enhancement adds 3 base damage and one mining tier. Spell power scales the damage, and every additional 25% spell power grants another mining tier.

Each creature left alive and each block left intact causes a separate backlash. You take 2 true damage and lose 10% of your current mana, with a minimum loss of 10 mana. When Infusion catches several targets, each backlash uses the remaining balance. If a backlash costs more mana than you have left, you die immediately.
Chaos Affinity prevents Error backlash damage, but still loses mana and dies from overdraw.
